This '''bunker''' was owned by [[Darth Skotia]] on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It served as his warehouse where his guard protected artifacts and relics. During [[Darth Nox]]'s apprenticeship to [[Darth Zash]], the young apprentice was assigned to infiltrate the bunker and acquire a [[Trandoshan relic|tablet]] to help them defeat Darth Skotia himself. A task which Nox [[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|completed]] successfully.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bunker first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] (MMORPG) by [[BioWare]] released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
